headline: Average five-year fixed mortgage rates in the UK reach 6 percent
summary: Property experts issued warnings as the average five-year fixed mortgage rate reached 6 percent in October.
why: Mortgage rates directly influence housing affordability, residential real estate transaction volumes, and consumer borrowing costs in the housing sector.

impacts.name: Housing
impacts.why: Higher mortgage rates reduce prospective homebuyer purchasing power and weigh on real estate market activity.
